page.layout: One printed page: running head at top (left "Cap. 10." and centred-left "Jugulum Causæ.", right page number 197); one text column of justified running text; at the foot a signature "N 3" at left-centre and the catchword-like word "ricorum" at right, which is the last word of the last line and is therefore part of the text. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Id etiam fidem facit accedere authoritatem
dogmatibus secundæ Classis non primæ ab
imperio Papali divitiis florenti, quod cum
sint dogmata primæ Classis difficiliora cognitu
altiorisque contemplationis; secundæ vero
Classis Δεύτερα aut materia de illis sint magis ob-
viæ & expositæ intelligentiæ, & pene ad cap-
tum rudiorum, in his tamen turpiter sem-
per erraverint Romanenses; in illis vero ple-
rumque sana docuerint & retinuerint, saltem
super eis elucidationes & enodationes rationi
consonas ediderint: quod docet ultrò &
destinatò Romanenses cespitare in plana via doc-
trinarum secundæ Classis: atque à sua cui-
que utilitate aliqua commoveri & abripi ad
arripienda ea secundæ Classis dogmata; nem-
pe quia magis faciunt ad supportandum Pa-
pæ imperium & augendam rem familiarem:
id clarius fiet per collationem Patrum impri-
mis Justini Martyris ad Doctores Romanen-
ses hodiernos, reputando illos in dogmati-
bus difficilioribus & altioris intellectûs gra-
viter cespitavisse, qualia sunt dogmata pri-
mæ Classis; at saniores extitisse in dogmati-
bus secundæ Classis: eam potissimam ob cau-
sam, quod viris sanctis solenne fuerit caligare
ad sublimia & difficilioris intelligentiæ,
adeoque pronus fuerit lapsus ad errorem; at recta
senserint in dogmatibus secundæ Classis quæ
sunt facilioris intellectûs, ut sunt doctrinæ de
Sacramentis, de statu mortuorum post hanc
vitam, de cultu aut Dei aut creaturarum, de
confessione peccatorum, de matrimonio cl-
ericorum

page.notes: The Greek word after "Classis" is partly illegible in the scan; transcribed as best possible. Right-hand word "ricorum" is the end of the last line, placed at right beside the signature. Some letters in the body are blurred (e.g. "Papali", "cespitare") but were read with reasonable confidence. The "2" and marks in the right margin are stray marks, not text.
